name: pi-harnmem
description: pi coding-agent extension for HarnMem, the cross-harness agent memory: byte-stable hot-index injection, memory tools, and session-end extraction. One shared store of plain, human-editable Markdown under ~/.harnmem — no server, no vector database, no embed
